exact_values_found: PR Newswire, Overland Park KS, Nov 4 2025 08:18 ET, 'News provided by Give Interactive': Vanguard Charitable 'has partnered with Give Interactive to modernize and scale its donor-advised fund recordkeeping function' after 'a comprehensive review ... of platforms across the industry'; quote from Chris Bennett, CIO. crt.sh first-seen dates: vanguard-sandbox.giveinteractive.com 2025-08-06; vanguard-staging 2025-10-02; vanguard-sandbox-k8s 2026-01-23; vanguardcharitable.giveinteractive.com (production-named) 2026-01-28 (latest 2026-09-01); vc-innov 2026-10-09. vanguardcharitable.giveinteractive.com resolves and returns 200 with <title>Give Interactive. vanguardcharitable.org login is an on-page '#login' control; account.vanguardcharitable.org CNAME www.vanguardcharitable.org.edgekey.net (Akamai); no giveinteractive.com link on the homepage.
discrepancies: Timing is wrong: the production-named tenant has had certificates since 2026-01-28 (crt.sh), and a Vanguard sandbox since 2025-08-06 - i.e. before the public announcement. 'Since ~Aug 2026' reflects certspotter's currently-valid-certificates view, not first issuance.

A production-named hostname is not go-live; Vanguard donors still log in on Vanguard's own Akamai-fronted domain, so cut-over status is unknown. A sandbox from Aug 2025 suggests a ~15+ month implementation.
